content: Kawahunitari kememɨte'u'ita

Merikɨtsɨ te'aitamete mekanixuawekaitɨni Kurutani 'anataɨye tau makayuyuipike hepatsie, muhɨriyatsie, muweritsie meta naitsarie haramara Meritexaniyu hatetsitayaritsie, metatsiere Riwanu paitɨ: hetitsixi, 'amuxeutsixi, kananeutsixi, peretseutsixi, heweutsixi meta kewutseutsixi memakuteitsie. Kepauka tewa'aitɨwamete memu'enana 'ixaheritsixi kememɨteyuriekai,
mekaniuyuparewieni yunaitɨ yamekateniuxata Kutsuhexi memɨtamienikɨ meta 'ixaheritsixi.
Kawahuni kiekatari mete'utamarieka Kutsuhexi Keriku 'Ahi kemɨtiwaruka'unakai,
mekateniutaxata kememɨtewa'irɨwiya. Tupiritsixi mekaniwarenɨ'ani, wapuxurima kuxitariteta yeye'imeta mete'utɨkɨme meta nawi kɨxauriyari winu mukatuarike hatsatsanime hamanetsikitɨkaimeta.
Yu'ixurikite mepɨte'anakatɨtɨkatei meripai timieme, yukakai xutɨkaimetsie mepeu'ukai hatapietɨkaimetsie, paa mepu'ɨkai kɨraraunime temɨxikiyari pɨhɨkɨtɨkai.

Mekanekɨne Kirikari 'aurie Kutsuhexi mematiteitsie mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ mekaniutiyuani, Kutsuhexi hɨxie meta 'ixaheritsixi wahɨxie: ―Tame 'ateewa paitɨ tepanexɨa xeime kwieyaritsie, tɨratu tepukuwewietɨwe xehamatɨa.
'Ixaheritsixi mɨpaɨ mekaniutiyuani: ―Matsi xeme xɨari 'ahurawa xepɨkiekatari, 'ayumieme tame tɨratu temuwewieni tepɨkayɨwawe xehamatɨa.
Mɨkɨ, mɨpaɨ Kutsuhexi mekateniutahɨawe: ―Tame tepɨtawaɨriya temɨtexe'uximayatsiriekakɨ. Kutsuhexi mɨpaɨ katiniwaruta'iwawiya: ―¿Kehate xeme xepɨyua hakewa xepeyekɨ?
Mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ mekaniutiyuani: ―Tame 'ateɨterima tepɨyɨa, tame kwie 'ateewa mukumatsie tepeyekɨ, hakewa 'ikɨ Kakaɨyari Yawé memariwatsiepaitɨ. Tepɨtehetamari naime 'Ekipitu kemɨtiuyuri,

meta te'aitamete yuhutame kemɨwaruyuri 'amuxeutsixi Kurutani 'aurie memɨtamakai: 'ikɨ mepɨhɨkɨtɨkai Tsikuni ti'aitame Hetsiwuni kwieyaritsie mieme, 'Uhuki ti'aitame Watsani kwieyaritsie mieme 'Atsitaruti kiekame.

'Ayumieme takie kiekatari meta memɨtatsi'uwitɨxime mɨpaɨ mepaitɨkatei kename tekeheyukuha'aritɨani 'ateewa temuhukɨ mɨpaɨ temɨtexetahɨawekɨ: “Tame tepɨtawaɨriya xeteɨterima temɨhɨkɨtɨnikɨ tɨratu temɨwewienikɨ”.
Kepauka temeyekɨ 'upɨta paa peyumemenikai xɨxɨkatɨ, peru hikɨ xekeneuxeiya kanikɨraraunini kanitemɨxikiyaka.
'Ikɨta nawi kɨxaɨriyari kaxie winuyari mukatuarike pehehekwakai hɨpɨnetɨ kaxie winuyari, hikɨ xeketeneuxeiya naitɨ katinitsatsanini ta'ixurikite meta takakai pɨxɨtɨka yeiyakɨ.
Teɨteri 'ixaheritsixi 'etsiwa kawahunitari wa'ikwai mekateniukwani, peru Yawé mepɨka'uta'iwawiyaxɨ.
Hikɨ Kutsuhexi tɨratu kaniuwewieni waparewienike naimekɨ, yaxeikɨata yakaniutayɨni mɨkawareuyehɨanikɨ. 'Ixaheritsixi wa'ukiyarima yamekaniutiyuani mɨkɨ tɨratu hepaɨtsita.
Haika tukari heutineku tɨratu memuwewitsie kawahunitari wahamatɨa, 'ixaheritsixi mekateniutamarieni kename 'ahurawa kiekatari meyɨakai.
'Ayumieme mekanekɨne haika tukari mekaneuye'axɨani mɨkɨ kiekaritetsie: Kawahuni, Kapira, Weruti meta Kiriati-Yeharini.

Peru 'ixaheritsixi mepɨka warutakwi, wa'ukiyarima wahamatɨa tɨratu memuwewiekaikɨ, mɨpaɨ meputiyua Yawé hɨxie 'ixaheritsixi wakakaɨyari kename mekawakwini. Mɨkɨ 'ixaheritsixi yunaitɨ mekaniuyeha'ani 'ukirawetsixi wahepaɨtsita.
'Ukirawetsixi mɨpaɨ mekaniutiyuani: ―Tame tɨratu tepuwewi Yawé 'Ixaheri Kakaɨyarieya hetsiemieme, temɨwarukwini tepɨkayɨwawe.
'Ipaɨ pɨta tekaniwayurikuni: tepɨkawakwini 'uximatɨarika te'upitɨarienikɨ, tɨratu te'uwewieka temɨte'itanikɨ.
Hikɨ hutarieka mɨpaɨ mekateniuxata. ―Mekaniu'uwakuni perutsɨ kɨ'ewemete meta hanɨwemete mekanihɨkɨtɨkakuni takiekaritsie. Mɨpaɨ mete'uxataka mekatenaye'atɨani tɨratu kememɨte'uwewi.
Hikɨ Kutsuhexi kawahunitari mɨpaɨ katiniwarutatieni: ―¿Titayari xetate'u'itaiyaxɨ kename 'ateewa xekiekatari xe'utiyuatɨ, 'ahurawa xekiekataritɨtɨ?
'Ena mɨtiyehane mɨpaɨ 'axaxepɨtepitɨarieni: Te'uximayatamete xepakɨne, Kakaɨyari tukieyata miemete. Kɨ'ewemete xepɨhɨkɨtɨni meta hanɨwemete.

Kawahunitari mɨpaɨ mekaniutiyuani: ―Tame texe'uximayatsiriwamete, tepɨte'utaxatɨarie kename Yawé xekakaɨyari mɨpaɨ tiuta'aitaxɨ Muitsexi ti'a'uximayatsiriwame, mɨxeyetuirienikɨ 'ikɨ kwie naime, xewakwitɨ teɨteri mana kiekatari, teputimama waɨkawa tekaheukwikutɨ 'ayumieme mɨyatepɨte'uyuri.
Tame xehetsiemieme tepɨhɨkɨ, yaxeketeneuyuri takɨmana kehepaɨ mɨtiheitserie kehepaɨ 'aixɨa mɨ'ane.
Mɨpaɨ Kutsuhexi katiniwarutawikweitsitɨani kawahunitari, 'ixaheritsixi mewakwikukaku.

'Ana mɨtiyetɨa Kutsuhexi kɨ'ewemete kaniwarayeitɨani meta hanɨwemete 'ixaheritsixi wahetsiemieme kepauka memuyuxeɨriekatsie, matsi yemekɨ mawari taiyame Yawé hetsiemieme mepɨte'uximayakai hakewa mɨkɨ Yawé menayexei. Hikɨ 'akuxi yaxeikɨa mɨpaɨ mepɨtehe'uximaya.
